message.content: {"caption":"A blue-framed text panel presents a memory-construction instruction for a conversational assistant.","description":"The picture is a single rectangular panel with a thin blue border and pale background. A bold teal heading reads “Prompt 1: Memory-construction instruction.” The paragraph instructs the model to maintain useful, accurate, source-backed, low-cost memory for a long-running daily chat. It lists memory_read, rag_search, meta_log_read, memory_change, memory_review, and model-created declarative memory tools. It says to verify recent or conflicting exact facts, prefer atomic facts with source-turn references, keep broad project profiles separate from exact facts, and not invent facts unsupported by the chat or tools.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
